MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled for hearing on Name Change. Present: Commissioner Loretta M. Norris; Clerk: P. Dias; Reporter: Patrick Heard. Petitioner Charles Jay Green, Jr. was sworn and examined. Good cause appearing, the Court grants the Decree changing Petitioner's name to Omar Al-Faruq. Decree signed in open court.
